## Verification

- [ ] Unit/tests, lint and relevant build checks executed (link logs)
- [ ] Security, permission and wrong-user/tenant tests evaluated when relevant
- [ ] Source code and documentation checked for version/status accuracy
- [ ] Reproducible steps, expected outputs and limitations documented
- [ ] Migration, rollout, rollback and resource/cost impact reviewed
- [ ] Sensitive data and secret scanning completed
- [ ] Live deployment acceptance **not** claimed without actual observed evidence

Provide test commands, results, versions, redacted logs and relevant image digests. A passing PR check is not a live deployment test.
